statement: The disjoint two-input AND block and arbitrary affine output coupling use case is decidable in polynomial total bit complexity with SAT witnesses or XOR inconsistency certificates.
hypotheses: Disjoint local blocks with explicitly allowed input pairs and no cross-block constraints except affine equations on their AND outputs.
definitions: Project each local block onto a one-bit allowed set, add singleton equations, solve GF(2) system, lift witness.
source_locators: PNP-B005; self-contained proof and standard Gaussian elimination.
proof_or_gap: Independence of block inputs gives exact lift of any output solution; row provenance gives 0=1 refutation if inconsistent. Polynomial bit complexity, no projected CNF materialization.
implication_to_claim: Completes the specified use case, not arbitrary SAT.
unproved_dependencies: Arbitrary overlapping gate networks and nonaffine cross-block constraints.
adversarial_findings: Empty local domain and contradictory XOR rows rejected; exhaustive small cases compared to brute force.
